notes.title: Launch Day has arrived!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I'm very excited to announce the release of Yokai Tales. Get your copy, and enjoy this Japanese tale that was based on my childhood JRPGs![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone for making this happen![/p]

notes.title: Yokai Tales Set to Launch on Steam August 4!
notes.content:
I'm very pleased to announce that Yokai Tales finally has a release date: August 4! 🌸🎮

Get ready to enter a world of Japanese folklore, in this JRPG-inspired Roguelite! It’s been an incredible journey bringing this game to life, and I can't wait for you all to experience it.

Mark your calendars, wishlist it on Steam, and prepare to meet the yokai!

notes.title: Yokai Tales Is Coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We’re excited to share that Yokai Tales will be featured in Steam Next Fest! 🎊

The demo is already live, so if you haven’t played it yet, now’s the perfect time to dive in and experience the mysterious world of Yokai Tales before the festival begins.

🧭 What awaits you in the demo:

Explore a richly detailed world inspired by Japanese folklore

Meet a cast of intriguing yokai and uncover hidden secrets

Get a taste of the story, atmosphere, and gameplay mechanics

During Steam Next Fest, we’ll also be sharing new content, answering your questions, and connecting with the community—so stay tuned!

🎮 Play the demo now, and don’t forget to wishlist Yokai Tales to follow our journey!

Thanks for your support—and see you in the spirit world!
